payload.reason: The evidence indicates that both single-language and multilingual BERT models perform well on structure-dependent agreement tasks, but does not definitively state that one outperforms the other across all contexts.

claims.text: Single-language BERT performs well on structure-dependent agreement tasks, achieving above 80% accuracy in cloze tests.
Multilingual BERT also captures syntax-sensitive agreement patterns, but specific performance comparisons are not detailed.
The performance of BERT models varies by language and task, suggesting context-dependent effectiveness rather than a clear superiority of single-language BERT.
